info.title: x402 master data API — 181 endpoints
info.description: 181 pay-per-call APIs: AI text/image generation ($0.01), Polymarket odds, crypto prices, DeFi yields, FX rates, weather, IP/geo, FBI wanted, SEC tickers, clinical trials, 250M academic papers, Stack Overflow, meme-coin launchpads (pump.fun, Clanker, Four.meme, SunPump), tokenized stocks, Solana top 100, and 40+ more. $0.005/call standard. USDC on Base and Solana via x402.
